slot.brief: Pointing-introduction style chain ('He is the son of my grandfather's only son'); determine the exact relationship between speaker and person.

stem: Pointing to a boy, Nita said, “He is the son of my father’s only son.” How is the boy related to Nita?

verdicts.working: Nita’s father’s only son is her brother; his son is her nephew.

working:
Nita’s father’s only son is her brother. The boy is her brother’s son, hence her nephew. A is the boy’s father; C and D do not fit the stated relation.
